Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q2 2022 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of GOOGL.
Our gross margin expanded by 87 basis points to 54.4%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 5% to 24% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q2 2022.
Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 371 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
How are you thinking about pricing power versus volume growth in the current environment?
Thank you for the question. We generated $5.2 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Second question - Analyst:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 87 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
